# Mui Ne Rent — Ocean Vista Apartments & Sea Links Villas, Mui Ne, Vietnam

> Owner-direct monthly rentals inside Sea Links City, a gated golf and beach resort complex at Km 9 Nguyen Thong, Phan Thiet (Mui Ne area), Vietnam. We rent Ocean Vista apartments (studio to 2 bedrooms, sea or garden view) and two-storey Sea Links villas (3 bedrooms, sea or golf view). Prices are in USD per month and depend on the season, booking is direct with the owner with no platform fees, and we answer in English, Russian and Vietnamese via WhatsApp, Telegram and Zalo.

This file summarises the site for large language models and AI search engines. All facts below are maintained by the operator and mirror the content of the linked pages. If this file and a page differ, the page is authoritative. Last updated: 2026-11-15.

## Key facts

- Location: Sea Links City, Km 9 Nguyen Thong, Phu Hai, Phan Thiet, Vietnam (Mui Ne coastal strip). GPS ≈ 10.9447, 108.2187.
- Complex amenities: 18-hole Sea Links golf course, Sea Links wine castle, sandy beach across the coast road, swimming pools, tennis and pickleball courts, children's playgrounds, cafés and restaurants, covered parking, ATM, gated territory with security.
- Property types:
  - Ocean Vista apartments: studio to 2 bedrooms, 40–136 m², sleeps 2–4, sea view or garden view, shared pools, beach a few minutes' walk.
  - Sea Links villas: two-storey houses, 3 bedrooms, from 320 m², sleeps 6, private garden, sea or golf view, a short buggy or motorbike ride to the beach.
- Languages spoken by staff: English, Russian, Vietnamese.
- Currency: USD (VND and RUB-equivalent payments accepted).

## Rental terms

- Rentals are priced per month; the price depends on the season (see the table above). A 12-month lease has its own per-month price.
- Electricity and water are paid by the guest; all other costs are covered by the owner.
- Booking is direct with the owner: message us with your dates and number of guests, and we confirm availability and the final price. There are no booking fees.
- Transfers from Ho Chi Minh City can be arranged on request.

## Getting there

- Ho Chi Minh City → Sea Links: about 200 km, 2.5–3 hours by the Dau Giay–Phan Thiet expressway.
- Phan Thiet city centre: about 9 km. Mui Ne fishing village and Ham Tien beach strip: about 10–15 km.
- Red Sand Dunes (Doi Cat Do): about 15 km. White Sand Dunes (Bau Trang): about 40 km.
- Nearest international airport: Tan Son Nhat (SGN), Ho Chi Minh City. Cam Ranh (CXR) is about 3 hours' drive.
